query:
insert into RequirementVerificationStates (
                latest_collection,
                product_id,
                req_id,
                state
            )
            select
                $1 as latest_collection,
                r.product_id,
                r.id,
                case
                    -- deprecated
                    when exists (
                        select dr.req_id
                        from DeprecatedRequirements dr
                        where r.product_id = dr.product_id
                        and r.id = dr.req_id
                    ) then $6
                    -- excluded
                    when exists (
                        select er.req_id
                        from ExcludedRequirements er
                        where r.product_id = er.product_id
                        and r.id = er.req_id
                    ) then $7
                    when exists (
                        select dr.req_id
                        from DraftRequirements dr
                        where r.product_id = dr.product_id
                        and r.id = dr.req_id
                    ) then $10
                    -- failed
                    when exists (
                        select fr.req_id
                        from FailedRequirements fr
                        where r.product_id = fr.product_id
                        and r.id = fr.req_id
                    ) then $3
                    -- skipped
                    when ds.state is not null and (ds.state = $4
                        or (
                            (ds.state = $5 or ds.state = $8) -- unknown or satisfied
                            and (ids.state is not null and ids.state = $4)
                        )
                    ) then $4
                    -- leaves: unknown, satisfied, partially verified, verified
                    --
                    -- directly verified reqs with only optional children
                    when exists (
                        select voc.req_id
                        from VerifiedRequirementsWithOnlyOptionalChildren voc
                        where r.product_id = voc.product_id
                        and r.id = voc.req_id
                    ) then $2
                    -- manual requirement
                    when exists(
                        select mr.req_id
                        from ManualRequirements mr
                        where mr.product_id = r.product_id
                        and mr.req_id = r.id
                    ) then
                        case
                            -- manual reqs must always be directly verified
                            when ds.state is not null and ds.state = $2
                            then
                                case
                                    -- no children
                                    when ids.state is null or ids.state = $2
                                    then $2
                                    -- directly verified, but children not verified => partially verified
                                    -- at least one child either partially verified, satisfied, or unknown
                                    else $9
                                end
                            -- missing direct verification, but (partially) verified directly or through children
                            when (ds.state is not null and ds.state = $9)
                                or (ids.state is not null and (ids.state = $9 or ids.state = $2))
                            then $9
                            -- satisfied
                            when exists (
                                select sr.req_id
                                from DirectlySatisfiedRequirements sr
                                where sr.product_id = r.product_id
                                and sr.req_id = r.id
                            ) then $8
                            -- unknown
                            else $5
                        end
                    -- partially verified
                    when ds.state is not null and (ds.state = $9
                        or (ids.state is not null
                            and (ids.state = $9
                                -- indirectly either satisfied or unknown for non-manual is left besides verified
                                or (ds.state = $2 and ids.state != $2)
                            )
                        )
                    ) then $9
                    -- verified
                    when ds.state is not null
                    and (
                        -- verified leaf
                        (ds.state = $2 and ids.state is null)
                        -- indirectly verified, direct verification is optional in this case
                        -- manual reqs handled above
                        or ids.state = $2
                    ) then $2
                    -- satisfied
                    when ds.state is not null and ds.state = $8
                    then $8
                    -- unknown
                    else $5
                end
            from Requirements r
                left join DirectRequirementVerificationStates ds
                    on r.product_id = ds.product_id
                    and r.id = ds.req_id
                left join IndirectRequirementVerificationStates ids
                    on r.product_id = ids.product_id
                    and r.id = ids.req_id
            where true
            on conflict (
                product_id,
                req_id
            ) do update
            set
                latest_collection = excluded.latest_collection,
                state = excluded.state
